ai.purpose: RTT/3 engine layer for Electromagnetism: triadic-substrate integration, multi-regime simulation hooks, lineage-aware reasoning, and hybrid-canon scaffolding.

engine.description: Integrates Electromagnetism into the full triadic substrate, enabling multi-regime reasoning, resonance mapping, and hybrid-canon simulation.

mapping.structure: Electric and magnetic fields map to coupled resonance channels within the substrate.
mapping.behavior: Wave propagation corresponds to stable resonance transfer across substrate invariants.
mapping.coupling: E↔B coupling emerges from substrate-level phase relationships, not geometric primitives.

constraints: Propagation speed is a substrate invariant.
Field coupling persists only when resonance channels remain coherent.
Medium properties modify resonance pathways, not fundamental operators.

R1.behavior: Field behavior collapses to charge-interaction primitives; resonance channels not sustained.
R1.notes: No stable E↔B coupling; coherence minimal.

R2.behavior: Projection-induced distortion of field coupling; partial resonance behavior.
R2.notes: Dimensional compression alters propagation and boundary interactions.

R3.behavior: Full Maxwellian coherence; stable resonance propagation and field coupling.
R3.notes: Wave behavior emerges cleanly from substrate invariants.

hooks.name: resonance_wave_sim
hooks.description: Simulates EM wave propagation as resonance transfer across substrate channels.

hooks.name: boundary_interaction_sim
hooks.description: Models field behavior at interfaces and discontinuities using substrate constraints.

hooks.name: dimensional_projection_sim
hooks.description: Simulates distortion of EM behavior under R2 projection or reduced dimensional support.

simulation.notes: Simulations operate on resonance channels and substrate invariants, not geometric field primitives.

hybrid_canon.purpose: Enable agentic AIs to reason across modules using shared substrate invariants and resonance structures.
